title: Fix Admin Dashboard backend connection timeout

requirements.text: Fix the Admin Dashboard access failure caused by backend connection timeout. The `useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout` hook and the actor initialization in `useActor.ts` must be coordinated so that the admin status check only fires after the authenticated actor is fully ready. Eliminate any race condition between Internet Identity login completion and the admin check query being enabled.

quotes: kein Zugang zum Adminbereich, Fehlermeldung: Zeitüberschreitung
Die Verbindung zum Backend hat zu lange gedauert. Bitte versuchen Sie es erneut.

acceptanceCriteria: After logging in via Internet Identity, the Admin Dashboard loads successfully without showing the timeout error message.
The admin status check (`isCallerAdmin`) is only initiated after the authenticated actor instance is confirmed ready.
If the backend call genuinely takes longer than expected, a retry mechanism attempts the request at least once before showing an error.
The timeout error screen ('Die Verbindung zum Backend hat zu lange gedauert') is not shown during normal authenticated admin login flow.

requirements.text: Ensure the backend actor in `useActor.ts` is always instantiated using the authenticated Internet Identity principal when the user is logged in. The actor must not fall back to an anonymous identity while an authenticated identity is available, which would cause admin-gated backend calls to fail silently or time out.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user is authenticated via Internet Identity, all backend calls in the admin area use the authenticated actor, not the anonymous one.
The actor is re-created and queries are invalidated whenever the identity changes (login/logout).
No admin backend call is made with an anonymous principal.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui — these are read-only. Implement fixes via wrapper hooks or updates to useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout.ts and AdminDashboard.tsx instead.
Do not change the backend Motoko actor schema or role-based access control logic.
nonGoals: Adding new admin features or dashboard UI changes beyond fixing the timeout/access issue.
Changes to NFT minting, collection management, or blog post functionality.
